newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Goldman starts Canadian oils.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Goldman starts Canadian oils.

text.p: -- Goldman Sachs said analyst Jim Mecca initiated a group of Canadian energy stocks.
-- started Canadian Natural Resources Ltd and Ranger Oil Ltd and added them to the recommended list.
-- initiated coverage of Alberta Energy Co Ltd, Amber Energy Inc, Anderson Exploration Ltd, Norcen Energy Resources Ltd and PanCanadian Petroleum Ltd as market outperform.
-- started Crestar Energy Inc, Canadian Occidental Petroleum Ltd, and Elan Energy Inc as market perform.
-- also downgraded Renaissance Energy Ltd to market perform from recommend list.
